This page lets you exercise your privacy choices with Corpcio. Full details are in our Privacy Policy.

Do not sell or share my personal information

Checking your browser for Global Privacy Control…

We do not sell personal information, and we do not share it for cross-context behavioural advertising or use it for targeted advertising. That applies to everyone automatically, so you don't need to do anything.

We treat a Global Privacy Control signal from your browser as a valid opt-out request. If you would also like a written record of your opt-out, use the form below and choose “Opt out of sale or sharing”.

Marketing emails

You can stop marketing emails at any time by using the unsubscribe link in any marketing email, or by choosing “Stop marketing emails” in the form below. We will act on it within 10 business days or sooner where the law requires. We will still send you messages you need about an engagement or a payment.

Cookies

This website sets no advertising, analytics or other non-essential cookies, so there are no cookie settings to change. Stripe's secure payment pages use cookies needed for payment and fraud prevention, as described in Stripe's cookie policy.

Make a privacy request

Use this form to opt out, or to access, correct, delete or get a copy of your personal information. It opens a pre-filled email in your email app, addressed to info@corpcio.com. Nothing is sent until you press send. If you prefer, you can simply email us directly.

Please enter your name and a valid email address, and tick the confirmation box.

Please don't include card numbers or other sensitive information in your request.

What happens next

  • We will acknowledge your request within 10 days.
  • We may ask you to confirm your identity, usually by replying from the email address we have on file. An authorised agent will need to show written permission from you.
  • We will respond in full within one month (45 days under US state laws). Where the law allows, we may extend this once if a request is complex, and we will tell you why.
  • There is no charge, and we will never treat you differently for exercising your rights.
  • Opt-out requests take effect as soon as possible and in any case within 15 business days.

If you're unhappy with our response, you can appeal by replying to it, or complain to your data protection authority as described in our Privacy Policy.
